active.name: Clinic manager
active.provenance: accountable_owner: role identified from the submission, no named individual; also in for_whom as 'clinic managers'

active.name: Waiting-list patient
active.provenance: for_whom: 'the patients on the waiting list'; also 'other patients wait weeks for an opening'

active.name: Booking and reminder system
active.provenance: Not named in the submission. Inferred: reminders are sent ('reminders are one-size-fits-all') and weekly attendance/slot-fill/reminder-effect figures are produced, so some system must hold bookings, send reminders and compile figures. Flagged as an inference, not a stated actor.

behavioural.name: book appointment
behavioural.provenance: From the scheduler/receptionist roles and references to 'bookings' and 'outpatient appointments'

behavioural.name: tailor reminder
behavioural.provenance: From the contrast with 'one-size-fits-all' reminders and the open question on whether consent covers 'all reminder channels and languages intended'. Distinct from 'send reminder': tailoring determines content/channel/language per patient.

behavioural.name: predict no-show
behavioural.provenance: From 'the clinic cannot tell which bookings are likely to be missed until the day itself' and 'predicted-empty slots'

behavioural.name: fill slot from waiting list
behavioural.provenance: From 'freed or predicted-empty slots are refilled from the waiting list instead of going unused'. Also expressed in the submission as 'refill slot'; both names refer to this one function.

behavioural.name: review weekly figures
behavioural.provenance: From expected_change: 'observable in the manager's weekly attendance, slot-fill, and reminder-effect figures'

behavioural.name: record consent
behavioural.provenance: From the open question: 'the consent recorded on the patient record'. Included as an existing function the reminder functions depend on, though only mentioned via an open question.

passive.name: Appointment booking
passive.provenance: From 'outpatient appointments' and 'bookings'; the submission uses both terms for the same object

passive.name: Slot
passive.provenance: From 'The slots go unused' and 'freed or predicted-empty slots'. Kept distinct from the booking: a slot is the capacity unit a booking occupies and that the fill function refills.

passive.name: Waiting list
passive.provenance: From 'the patients on the waiting list' and 'refilled from the waiting list'

passive.name: No-show prediction
passive.provenance: Not named in the submission. Implied by 'tell which bookings are likely to be missed' — the per-booking risk indication the predict function produces and the fill function consumes. Flagged as inference.

passive.name: Weekly performance figures
passive.provenance: From 'the manager's weekly attendance, slot-fill, and reminder-effect figures'

passive.name: Consent record
passive.provenance: From the open question: 'consent recorded on the patient record'; the consent record is part of the patient record, which is not otherwise mentioned
